leadText: Jerry Lobozzo (born in Irvington, New Jersey) is an American voice actor for the English dub of Pokémon the Series.
plainText:
Jerry Lobozzo (born in Irvington, New Jersey) is an American voice actor for the English dub of Pokémon the Series.

==Biography==
Lobozzo was born in Irvington, New Jersey, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined Pokémon the Series during its first season. During his first three seasons of working on the series, Lobozzo was only credited by his last name; he was credited by his full name afterwards. He last did voices for the fourth season and Pokémon Chronicles.
